advancement.oborokage.moon.title: Sheathed Before Moonset
advancement.oborokage.moon.description: Slay at least three non-player creatures in one fully charged iaido, taking no damage until recovery ends.
tooltip.oborokage.charge: Hold use for 2 seconds; release to draw
tooltip.oborokage.flavor: Moonlight on the edge. Shadow before sound.
tooltip.oborokage.wakizashi: Offhand partner for any Oborokage blade; drawn alone it has its own ultimate
tooltip.oborokage.controls: Attack to alternate; rebind guard, step and ultimate in Controls.
advancement.oborokage.first_moon.title: Oborokage Chronicle: First Moonrise
advancement.oborokage.twin_moons.title: Two Moons, One Path
advancement.oborokage.twin_moons.descrip: Hold the tachi and wakizashi together for a second.
advancement.oborokage.alternating_finish: Land both hands of a combo and finish a hostile with its cross-cut.
advancement.oborokage.borrowed_blade.tit: A Blade Borrowed, a Moon Returned
advancement.oborokage.borrowed_blade.des: Perfect-guard and defeat that attacker with the counter.
advancement.oborokage.decisive_step.desc: Complete a shadow step and promptly land an offhand strike.
advancement.oborokage.three_breaths.desc: Perfect-guard three distinct attacks within twenty seconds, unharmed.
advancement.oborokage.break_and_cut.desc: Break posture and cross-cut within the opening.
advancement.oborokage.twin_moon_ultimate: Defeat a hostile with the dual ultimate finishing cut.
advancement.oborokage.flawless_night.des: Defeat five hostiles with at least three dual actions in sixty seconds; land both hands and take no damage.
tooltip.oborokage.storm: 20 ticks to full charge: a swift close assault.
tooltip.oborokage.terrain: Sneak and charge: cut blocks or connected logs. More charge cuts more.
tooltip.oborokage.frost: 40 ticks to full charge: a radial cut that slows nearby foes.
tooltip.oborokage.void: 40 ticks to full charge: a wall-blocked energy line up to 28 blocks.
ui.oborokage.guide: Attack for the dual chain; hold use to charge a technique; sneak-charge to cut terrain. %s guard · %s step · %s ultimate (at 100 intent, any blade unleashes its own).
ui.oborokage.key_conflict: Oborokage key conflict: %s and %s share a key. Rebind in Controls.
Cut at least sixteen logs with one harvesting action.
advancement.oborokage.frost_truce.title: Frostbound Truce
advancement.oborokage.frost_truce.descri: Slow three hostiles with one Frostmoon technique.
advancement.oborokage.far_bank.title: Across the Far Bank
advancement.oborokage.far_bank.descripti: Land a Voidstring technique on a hostile at least sixteen blocks away.
advancement.oborokage.five_paths.title: Five Blades, One Path
advancement.oborokage.five_paths.descrip: Carry all five Oborokage blades at once.
advancement.oborokage.afterimage.title: Afterimage
advancement.oborokage.afterimage.descrip: Slip an attack in the opening instant of a Shadow Step.
advancement.oborokage.thunder_chain.desc: With Raikiri as the main blade, chain a cross cut's lightning into two more enemies.
tooltip.oborokage.art.tachi: Dual finisher · Eclipse: the cross cut breaks posture faster
tooltip.oborokage.art.storm: Dual finisher · Thunder Chain; a full-charge kill recalls the assault almost at once
tooltip.oborokage.art.frost: Dual finisher · Rime: three stacks freeze; full charge rings again after half a second
tooltip.oborokage.art.void: Dual finisher · Void Edge; full charge leaves a mark that dual hits detonate
tooltip.oborokage.ult.tachi: Ultimate · Twin Moons: a moon rises, two moons cross, the heavens are cut (1000 · execution)
tooltip.oborokage.ult.moon: Ultimate · Hundred Flowers: eight whirling cuts, the ninth blooms
tooltip.oborokage.ult.storm: Ultimate · Ten Thousand Thunders: blink through six foes, thunder falls at the end
tooltip.oborokage.ult.frost: Ultimate · Mirror Moon: freeze a 12-block lake, then shatter it
tooltip.oborokage.ult.void: Ultimate · Severing the Realms: draw the sky's string and cut 48 blocks of world, through walls
advancement.oborokage.all_ultimates.desc: Unleash the ultimate of all five blades.
advancement.oborokage.shake_heavens.desc: Fell a foe with at least 150 health using an ultimate.
tooltip.oborokage.solo.tachi: Alone · three-cut chain; finisher "Waning Moon": the blade's shadow cuts again
tooltip.oborokage.solo.moon: Alone · three-cut chain; finisher "Falling Petals": a full turn that quickens the feet
tooltip.oborokage.solo.storm: Alone · three-cut chain; finisher "Thunderflash": lightning leaps to enemies beyond reach
tooltip.oborokage.solo.frost: Alone · three-cut chain; every cut frosts, finisher "Frost Bloom" rings out a chill
tooltip.oborokage.solo.void: Alone · three-cut chain; finisher "Void Edge": sword-qi pierces the rank behind
ui.oborokage.guide_solo: One blade drawn: attack for a three-cut chain (the third is the blade's finisher), aimed wherever you look; hold use to charge a technique; %s ultimate (at 100 intent). Put the wakizashi in your offhand for two blades.
inscription.oborokage.zanshin.desc: Zanshin after an ultimate lasts twice as long
inscription.oborokage.feather.desc: Aerial plunge and string dash recover twice as fast
inscription.oborokage.dew.desc: Each enemy this blade fells restores a food point
inscription.oborokage.crimson.desc: The blade's light burns crimson and gold (cosmetic)
tooltip.oborokage.intent_crystal: Use: gather %s intent at once. Also cut into inscription stones.
tooltip.oborokage.inscription_stone: Put it in an anvil with a blade to inscribe it for %s levels; a new inscription replaces the old, but an ancient blade keeps its Ancient inscription
tooltip.oborokage.training_dummy: Plants a straw-wrapped post that only sways when struck and reads out each hit, the combo and damage per second. Sneak-use with an empty hand to take it back
tooltip.oborokage.relic: A relic from a blade tomb, or the broken blade of a Lord of Fallen Petals. Craft it with a netherite ingot and its theme material to restore an ancient blade
ui.oborokage.fatigued: Spent · the blade's arts are silent (eat to recover)
ui.oborokage.whetstone_needs_flint: Honing takes a piece of flint
codex.oborokage.title: Oborokage · Move Codex
codex.oborokage.dual_chain.desc: Main cut, offhand return cut, cross cut. The cross carries the main blade's art; three hits on one enemy break its posture.
codex.oborokage.guard.desc: The first fifth of a second is a precise guard that cancels the blow and returns arrows; attack right after for the counter.
codex.oborokage.step.desc: A 2.8-block step. A blow in its first 3 ticks is evaded outright, and the next cut lands ×1.5.
codex.oborokage.plunge.desc: Drive straight down; the landing strikes all around (heavier from higher, up to +24). The first 12 blocks of the dive deal no fall damage; a fall already under way still counts. Each blade lands differently. Costs hunger; 1 s recovery.
codex.oborokage.intent.desc: Hits, precise guards, evasions, techniques and draws all build intent, which holds at 100; J unleashes the drawn blade's ultimate. An intent crystal adds 25.
codex.oborokage.vigor.desc: Every blade ability costs hunger: a little per swing, more for techniques, draws and plunges, most for ultimates. At 6 food (three drumsticks) or less you are spent: blade arts and finishers fall silent and plunges and string dashes are unavailable until you eat.
codex.oborokage.terrain.desc: Cuts logs and a bounded face of blocks, keeping vanilla drops and protection rules.
codex.oborokage.whetstone.input: Use a whetstone with a blade (spends a flint)
codex.oborokage.whetstone.desc: Honed for five minutes: 5% more damage, brighter light. Sneak-use it holding a kazuuchi with 6 blade souls to grind it into a wakizashi. Mine it with a pickaxe to take it back.
codex.oborokage.inscription.desc: Zanshin (twice as long), Focus (+15% intent), Featherfoot (half recovery for plunge and string dash), Dew (kills restore food), Crimson Moon (light colour). One per blade; a new one replaces the old, except an ancient blade's Ancient inscription.
codex.oborokage.swordsman.input: Cherry groves (day and night), swordsman dojos
codex.oborokage.swordsman.desc: A hostile swordsman with a kazuuchi. Between cuts it circles you and switches sides; it rushes you while you charge a draw, circles faster round a raised shield and backs off when badly hurt. It parries (more often when hurt, never an ultimate or a full-charge draw), counters, and often steps back after a cut. Strike one and the idle swordsmen nearby join in; with nothing to fight it practises on a training post nearby. It keeps to its own ground (a dojo's swordsmen keep to the yard). Sworn enemy of the Oni Beneath the Blossoms; zombies, skeletons and other undead attack it too (zombified piglins do not). Drops an intent crystal 1% of the time and never a broken blade.
codex.oborokage.tomb.input: A small shrine on the surface of forests and plains
codex.oborokage.tomb.desc: The chest before the stele holds a broken blade (the only place to find a broken wakizashi). Broken blade + netherite ingot + theme material restores an ancient blade with the Ancient Mark (30% less hunger). Oni Beneath the Blossoms keep watch at night. The first time anything is taken from the chest, lightning strikes the rod and two or three Oni Beneath the Blossoms rise (just looking is safe).
codex.oborokage.dummy.desc: A straw-wrapped post that sways away from each blow but never falls; shows each hit, the combo and DPS. It gives no intent and does not wax the moon.
codex.oborokage.tachi_solo.desc: Falling, rising, stepping cuts; finisher Waning Moon: the shadow cuts again after 0.3 s (45%).
codex.oborokage.tachi_iaido.desc: A full draw dashes ~15 blocks; everything passed stands frozen and falls together at the sheath (1000 + execution).
codex.oborokage.tachi_moon.desc: Each landed swing waxes the moon; at the full moon the next draw is a full draw however briefly held, and the moon returns to new.
codex.oborokage.tachi_ult.desc: Two crossing moons, then the cut that splits the moon; the last blow is 1000 with execution.
codex.oborokage.moon_solo.desc: A lighter, quicker chain; finisher Falling Petals: a full turn that quickens your feet.
codex.oborokage.moon_bloom.desc: Leaves a petal ring for 3 s: you, players you cannot harm (everyone while PvP is off) and your pets in it heal 1 health a second, paid from your hunger; it stops when you are spent.
codex.oborokage.moon_offhand.desc: Pairs with any main blade for the return cut, the cross, the guard and the step.
codex.oborokage.moon_ult.desc: Eight whirling cuts weave a cage of light; the ninth blooms (×4.5), all around.
codex.oborokage.storm_solo.desc: Finisher Thunderflash: lightning leaps from those struck to enemies nearby.
codex.oborokage.storm_tech.desc: A straight assault; a full-charge kill readies it again at once.
codex.oborokage.storm_mark.desc: Every hit lays a mark; the fifth calls real lightning: extra damage and vanilla lightning effects (a creeper is charged), no fires.
codex.oborokage.storm_ult.desc: Blink through up to six enemies, a bolt at each, and a pillar of thunder at the end.
codex.oborokage.frost_solo.desc: Every cut frosts, three freeze; finisher Frost Bloom slows and rings out ice.
codex.oborokage.frost_tech.desc: A ring of frost; at full charge it answers itself half a second later.
codex.oborokage.frost_ice.desc: The ground glazes for 3 s: enemies slow and skid, you run faster.
codex.oborokage.frost_ult.desc: A twelve-block lake freezes everything, then one cut shatters it (frozen ×1.6).
codex.oborokage.void_solo.desc: Finisher Void Edge: sword-qi runs on along the line of sight.
codex.oborokage.void_tech.desc: A line of sword-qi up to 28 blocks; full charge leaves a void mark.
codex.oborokage.void_string.input: After a full void line strikes, V
codex.oborokage.void_string.desc: The line leaves a string to the farthest enemy it struck (5 s); V dashes along it and cuts on arrival. Costs hunger; 2 s recovery.
codex.oborokage.void_ult.desc: Cuts 48 blocks of sky and earth along the line of sight, through walls.
tooltip.oborokage.kazuuchi: The plainest tachi, forged by the dozen. It cuts the single-blade chain but has no trait, technique or ultimate; every named blade is forged from one
tooltip.oborokage.blade_soul: What an Oni Beneath the Blossoms leaves behind. Sneak-use a whetstone holding a kazuuchi with %s of these to grind it into a wakizashi
item.oborokage.blossom_oni_spawn_egg: Oni Beneath the Blossoms Spawn Egg
item.oborokage.petal_lord_spawn_egg: Lord of Fallen Petals Spawn Egg
ui.oborokage.whetstone_needs_souls: Not enough blade souls (%s / %s) to grind the kazuuchi into a wakizashi
codex.oborokage.kazuuchi.input: Two iron ingots and a stick, on the diagonal
codex.oborokage.kazuuchi.desc: The plainest tachi, the one swordsmen carry. It cuts the single-blade chain, with no trait, technique or ultimate. Oborokage, Raikiri, Frostmoon and Voidstring are all forged from one; sneak-use a whetstone with 6 blade souls to grind it into a wakizashi.
codex.oborokage.blossom_oni.input: Cherry grove surface at night (common; never in the caves below), blade tombs
codex.oborokage.blossom_oni.desc: The ghost of a swordsman buried under the cherry trees: half-seen and torn, legless and one-armed, still gripping the broken blade it died with. It does not circle: it drifts straight in, and from a few blocks off lunges with a wail. Struck, it sometimes fades into soul-fire and comes back behind its attacker with a cut, and it calls its own kind nearby. It burns in daylight but makes for the shade, where the fire soon goes out. It drifts: it takes no fall damage, does not drown, and neither freezes in nor sinks into powder snow. Parries now and then. Sworn enemy of the living swordsmen and their master. Drops bones, blade souls (33%) and, one time in ten, an intent crystal.
codex.oborokage.petal_lord.desc: The dojo's master, carrying Oborokage, Raikiri, Frostmoon or Voidstring (25% each); keeps to its hall, parries and counters often (never an ultimate or a full-charge draw). Every few seconds it gathers itself, flash-steps to your side and cuts with its blade's nature; below half health it draws more often. No single blow takes more than 60 from it. The Oni Beneath the Blossoms and other undead attack it. The only mob that drops broken blades (its own, 7.9%). Its cuts sweep, its flash-step cuts everything on the way, and against several foes, a strong one, or below half health it calls its blade's ultimate (named on screen as it gathers). It stands still while it gathers. When it takes a foe, its students nearby turn on it too; out of a fight for a while, it slowly recovers. It speaks: to a challenger, at half health, and as it falls.
codex.oborokage.dojo.input: A building in cherry groves (most groves a hundred blocks across or more have one)
codex.oborokage.dojo.desc: A dojo behind a torii, stone lanterns and a gravel yard. Swordsmen and training posts in the yard, the Lord of Fallen Petals in the hall, and behind it a chest with kazuuchi, blade souls, intent crystals and now and then an inscription stone.
codex.oborokage.mounted.input: Cut as usual riding, in a boat or minecart, gliding or flying
codex.oborokage.mounted.desc: On a mount, in a boat or minecart, gliding on elytra or in creative flight the blade still chains, charges and draws. Gliding or flying, the draw follows your eyes: charge in the air, release at the bottom of the dive and the cut lands where you look, then the glide carries on. Mounted, the draw cuts ahead while the mount keeps its course. The step, the string dash, the plunge and the ultimate need your own feet.
advancement.oborokage.three_tombs_lit.de: All who fought for these blades lie in their tombs. You took nothing, lit their candles, and left the glory with the dead.
ui.oborokage.lord_says.fall: "The petals fall... and go back to the dust."
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.oborokage: Long-blade iaido, two-blade chains, precise guards and twin-moon ultimates.
ui.oborokage.language.hint: Changes only this mod's text, at once. The game's own language stays under Options → Language.
